description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans framework, focusing on various identifier types such as GrainId, UniqueKey, SiloAddress, and related functionality. It includes tests for serialization, parsing, interning, and object equality to ensure robustness of the identifier implementations.

classes.name: IdentifierTests
classes.description: Unit tests class for various Orleans identifier types including GrainId, UniqueKey, SiloAddress, and GrainReference.

methods.name: GrainIdUniformHashCodeIsStable
methods.description: Verifies that GrainId.GetUniformHashCode returns a consistent, stable value.

methods.name: UniqueKeyKeyExtGrainCategoryDisallowsNullKeyExtension
methods.description: Tests that UniqueKey creation throws an exception when key extension is null.

methods.name: UniqueKeyKeyExtGrainCategoryDisallowsEmptyKeyExtension
methods.description: Tests that UniqueKey creation throws an exception when key extension is empty.

methods.name: UniqueKeyKeyExtGrainCategoryDisallowsWhiteSpaceKeyExtension
methods.description: Tests that UniqueKey creation throws an exception when key extension is whitespace.

methods.name: ParsingUniqueKeyStringificationShouldReproduceAnIdenticalObject
methods.description: Confirms that parsing the stringified form of a UniqueKey reproduces the original object exactly.

methods.name: GrainIdShouldEncodeAndDecodePrimaryKeyGuidCorrectly
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of GrainId with Guid primary keys.

methods.name: GrainId_ToFromPrintableString
methods.description: Tests conversion of GrainId to string and back, ensuring serialization integrity.

methods.name: GrainId_TryParseFromPrintableString
methods.description: Tests tolerant parsing of GrainId from string form.

methods.name: GrainId_RoundTripJsonConverter
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization and deserialization of GrainId.

methods.name: TestGrainIds
methods.description: Provides data sets of various GrainId instances for parameterized tests.

methods.name: UniqueTypeCodeDataShouldStore32BitsOfInformation
methods.description: Ensures that UniqueKey stores 32 bits of data in its type code.

methods.name: UniqueKeysShouldPreserveTheirPrimaryKeyValueIfItIsGuid
methods.description: Verifies that UniqueKey preserves correct GUID primary key value and extension.

methods.name: UniqueKeysShouldPreserveTheirPrimaryKeyValueIfItIsLong
methods.description: Verifies that UniqueKey preserves correct long primary key value and extension.

methods.name: ID_Interning_GrainID
methods.description: Tests interning of GrainId objects to ensure identical IDs reference the same object.

methods.name: ID_Interning_string_equals
methods.description: Tests string interning for identifiers to ensure object identity and equality.

methods.name: ID_InternOrCreate_derived_class
methods.description: Tests interning behavior with derived classes and ensures correct instance caching.

methods.name: Interning_SiloAddress
methods.description: Tests interning of SiloAddress to ensure identical addresses reference the same object.

methods.name: Interning_SiloAddress2
methods.description: Verifies SiloAddress interning correctness with different addresses.

methods.name: Interning_SiloAddress_Serialization
methods.description: Ensures serialized and deserialized SiloAddress objects are interned correctly.

methods.name: SiloAddress_ToFrom_ParsableString
methods.description: Tests converting SiloAddress to and from string representations for correctness.

methods.name: GrainReference_Test1
methods.description: Tests creation, serialization, and roundtrip operations of GrainReference objects.

methods.name: TestGrainReference
methods.description: Helper method to test equality and serialization of GrainReferences.

methods.name: RoundTripGrainReferenceToKey
methods.description: Converts a GrainReference to a string key and back to test consistency.
